url.description: Webhook URL. Must match the lease's egress_allowlist; arbitrary public POSTs are not authorized.

body.description: JSON-serializable payload. Runner serializes with stable key ordering for receipt-friendly diffs.

headers.description: Custom request headers. Auth headers are NOT accepted here — auth is injected by the runner from the lease's named secret.

auth_secret_name.description: Name of the Hermes secret to inject as the bearer/HMAC credential for this call. Must appear in the lease's secrets.read scope.

idempotency_key.description: Forwarded as Idempotency-Key header. Required for re-tries on at-least-once webhooks.

delivered.description: True iff status is 2xx. The receiving system's downstream processing is NOT verified by this card.

summary: Authenticated POST to an allowlisted webhook (Slack, Discord, custom). Idempotency key supported; auth injected from Hermes secret, never from planner input.
notes: The lease pins the legal target hosts; expanding to a new webhook host means a new lease, not a new planner-supplied URL. This prevents prompt-injected URL substitution.
